body: The package on the porch feels heavy and oddly familiar, as if it were sent from far away. Its weight tells me something unexpected—this isn't just an ordinary delivery, but one left behind accidentally. The faint ticking suggests an alarm might be inside, yet I can't discern the source clearly due to its proximity and low volume. My instinct compels me to investigate further, feeling that uncovering this mystery could lead to understanding or even finding a solution for others who may have experienced similar misfortunes.
